about.meta.title: What FMIP is
about.meta.description: Live scores and match centres, a statistical forecast, the founder’s analysis and members’ predictions, kept apart, and a rating earned by predicting.
about.football.title: Football, match by match
about.football.body: Live scores and a page for every match: the timeline, line-ups, statistics, who will miss it and each side’s form, with every competition’s table beside them. When something is missing for a match, its page says so rather than showing an empty box, and every live number says when it last changed.
about.competitions.unreachable: The list of competitions could not be read just now.
about.three.title: Three kinds of prediction, never mixed
about.three.model.name: The statistical model.
about.three.model.body: A forecast computed before kick-off from the teams’ results, with the probabilities of a home win, a draw and an away win. Each version is kept as it was made, and after the match it is scored against what happened.
about.three.founder.name: The founder’s analysis.
about.three.founder.body: Written and signed by a person, for selected matches.
about.three.community.name: The community.
about.three.community.body: Members’ own predictions. Their combined view appears once at least five members have predicted a match, beside a second one weighted only by members whose ratings are established.
about.three.apart: The three are shown side by side and never blended into one number.
about.rating.title: A rating you earn by predicting
about.rating.body: Predict the outcome before kick-off, with how confident you are and, if you like, the exact score; at kick-off the prediction is locked, and every version you submitted is kept. Your rating grows most from being right when it was hard to be right — how hard is the model’s own probability, fixed before kick-off — and also from exact scores, consistency, and confidence that matched the outcome.
